title: GNSS: UBX message dissector additions and improvements
description:
Add dissectors for UBX-NAV-TIMEUTC, UBX-RXM-RAWX, and UBX-NAV-SBAS messages of u-blox GNSS receivers.
Minor improvements to UBX-NAV-SAT dissector.

notes.body: changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14151/diffs?diff_id=907225010&start_sha=153f668a89e325fc7e5a75a28cd83d2870446709#4338aaed7023d4549ff5356a19ccd70266d5c041_20_19)
Do you need multiple instances of this value_string? Why not remove static and extern the symbol.
This is where we have proto_tree_add_bitmask() for. Here and other places.

commits_data.title: GNSS: add dissector for UBX-RXM-RAWX messages of u-blox GNSS receivers
commits_data.message:
GNSS: add dissector for UBX-RXM-RAWX messages of u-blox GNSS receivers

Add dissector for UBX-RXM-RAWX messages of u-blox GNSS receivers.

commits_data.title: Move unit string for cycles to unit_strings.h
commits_data.message:
Move unit string for cycles to unit_strings.h

Move unit string for cycles to unit_strings.h from packet-usb-i1d3.c to
allow for usage by other dissectors.

commits_data.title: GNSS: use proto_tree_add_bitmask() for UBX bitmask fields
commits_data.message:
GNSS: use proto_tree_add_bitmask() for UBX bitmask fields

Use proto_tree_add_bitmask() for bitmask fields of UBX messages.

commits_data.title: GNSS: replace usage of "^2" by UTF8_SUPERSCRIPT_TWO
commits_data.message:
GNSS: replace usage of "^2" by UTF8_SUPERSCRIPT_TWO

Replace usage of "^2" by UTF8_SUPERSCRIPT_TWO in value_strings

commits_data.title: GNSS: add dissector for UBX-NAV-SBAS messages
commits_data.message:
GNSS: add dissector for UBX-NAV-SBAS messages

Add dissector for UBX-NAV-SBAS messages of u-blox GNSS receivers.

commits_data.title: GNSS: Map GNSS ID in UBX-NAV-SAT SV info subtrees
commits_data.message:
GNSS: Map GNSS ID in UBX-NAV-SAT SV info subtrees

Map the GNSS ID in the UBX-NAV-SAT SV info subtrees

commits_data.title: GNSS: reduce ett_ubx_nav_sat_sv_info length
commits_data.message:
GNSS: reduce ett_ubx_nav_sat_sv_info length

Reduce ett_ubx_nav_sat_sv_info length to 255 entries as a UBX-NAV-SAT
message may include 255 SV infos at most.

commits_data.title: GNSS: make available SBAS UDREI mapping to other files
commits_data.message:
GNSS: make available SBAS UDREI mapping to other files

Make available SBAS UDREI mapping to other files to enable usage in
other dissectors (e.g. UBX).

commits_data.title: GNSS: add dissector for UBX-NAV-TIMEUTC messages
commits_data.message:
GNSS: add dissector for UBX-NAV-TIMEUTC messages

Add dissector for UBX-NAV-TIMEUTC messages of u-blox GNSS receivers.
